notes: Card: peaks on ' l', ' л', '.L', '/L', '-L', '(L' where the token is only the first letter of a longer word. Probes: '-L' of Medical-Legal 0.52, ' л' of логичное 0.24, ' l' of ltr 0.23; whole-word tokens (lego, LLC, Linaria) 0.00; '-E' of Medical-Ethical 0.06. Depends on how the tokenizer splits the word.
